assertions.title: Native loader classpath resource paths match classified JAR contents

steps.action: Read FeagiNativeLibrary.java and extract the resource path pattern
steps.observed: extractAndLoad() method constructs: resourcePath = "native/" + platform + "/" + libFilename. Platform is os + "-" + arch. OS detection: linux→"linux", mac→"osx", windows→"windows". Arch detection: amd64/x86_64→"x86_64", aarch64/arm64→"aarch64". Library filenames: linux→"libfeagi_java_ffi.so", osx→"libfeagi_java_ffi.dylib", windows→"feagi_java_ffi.dll".
Contains: META-INF/, META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, native/, native/linux-x86_64/, native/linux-x86_64/libfeagi_java_ffi.so
Contains: META-INF/, META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, native/, native/linux-aarch64/, native/linux-aarch64/libfeagi_java_ffi.so
Contains: META-INF/, META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, native/, native/osx-x86_64/, native/osx-x86_64/libfeagi_java_ffi.dylib
Contains: META-INF/, META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, native/, native/windows-x86_64/, native/windows-x86_64/feagi_java_ffi.dll

steps.action: Compare loader resource path pattern with all 5 classified JAR contents
steps.observed: All 5 match: linux-x86_64 ✓, linux-aarch64 ✓, osx-x86_64 ✓, osx-aarch64 ✓, windows-x86_64 ✓

evidence.loaderPattern: resourcePath = "native/" + platform + "/" + libFilename (line in extractAndLoad method)

summary: Tested 1 assertion: 1 passed. The native loader's resource path pattern (native/{platform}/{libfilename}) exactly matches the paths inside all 5 classified JARs. A consumer adding sdk-native + a platform-classified dependency will have the native library discoverable by the loader.
